reviews.title: Great for parties or any special occasion
reviews.body: Great Value and Perfect for PartiesThe Pureegg Plastic Table Cloth Disposable 10 Pack, 84'' Round Table Cloths worked perfectly for my event. The size (84 inches round) fit our tables well and gave them a clean, neat look. These disposable tablecloths are made from thickened PEVA plastic, which helps them resist spills and stains while protecting the table underneath.I was happy with the quality—the plastic is lightweight but still sturdy enough for a party or gathering without tearing easily. The white color also looks simple and elegant, so it works well for weddings, picnics, or casual parties.Cleanup was the best part. Since they’re disposable, you can just roll them up and throw them away after the event, which saves a lot of time compared to washing fabric tablecloths.Overall, this pack is a great value because you get multiple tablecloths that are easy to use, look nice, and make party cleanup quick and simple. I would definitely buy them again! 🎉Read moreRead less

features: FIT ANY RETANGLE TABLES: Pureegg disposable tablecloths for rectangle tables measure 54" x 108" and fit tables up to 8 feet long. These plastic table cloths also fit smaller tables or various kinds of tables, like folding buffets, outdoor picnic, kitchen, and dining tables.

BUDGET FRIENDLY OPTION: Our disposable table cloths for parties come in a variety of vivid colors to choose from. Whether for indoor/outdoor dining, decorating, or daily use, our 10-pack is a cost-effective option.

MATERIAL INTRODUCTION: Made from plastic material, Pureegg party tablecloths are waterproof and stain-resistant, helping protect your table from spills and stains. Please note that this is a single-use plastic product with limited flexibility, avoid pulling or stretching it forcefully during use.
EASY CLEAN-UP: Just enjoy the party! Pureegg plastic tablecloths make cleanup a breeze! They are single-use so you can discard them after use, saving time and money on washing.

FOR ALL OCCASIONS: With the universal size and multiple color options, our disposable table cloths are widely applicable to kinds of events, parties, church functions, work events, one-time use, and even practical everyday use.
